## Change
Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation
- [ ] `pnpm dev:check`
- [ ] `pnpm release:check` when release-bound
- [ ] Migration impact reviewed
- [ ] New dependency reviewed
- [ ] New environment variable documented
- [ ] i18n impact reviewed

## Review triggers
- [ ] Security impact
- [ ] Privacy impact
- [ ] Legal impact
- [ ] Auth/RBAC/Tenant/Billing/Admin/Upload/Crypto/Secret change
- [ ] New personal-data category, analytics event, vendor or region
